label: OpenOCR hard subset
aggregate_note: Qualified whole-document comparison; normalized within its own protocol, at most one contribution per family. At least two distinct model identities required.
note: OpenOCR's 20-page hard corpus is separate from full olmOCR-Bench and from its 11-image everyday test. Each popover retains the exact source, run scope and any backend/version limitations.
aggregate_caveat: Tiny evaluation corpus: OpenOCR uses only 20 pages; the comparative model count does not establish broad document coverage.
